findings.description: Santiago Gonzalez and Petra Tumbaco had a son, Manuel de Jesus Gonzalez Tumbaco, born 1915 and died 5 December 1985 in Ecuador, in addition to their two daughters already in the tree (Maria Angela b. 1921, Maria Bartola b. 1934).
supporting_sources: Ecuador, Cemetery Records, 1862-2020 — burial entry for Manuel de Jesus Gonzalez Tumbaco, naming parents Santiago Gonzalez and Petita Tumbaco (ark:/61903/1:1:8DNC-SBZM)

Ecuador, Cemetery Records, 1862-2020 — burial entry for the couple's daughter Bartola Gonzalez Tumbaco, independently naming the same parents with the mother's name in full as Petra Tumbaco (ark:/61903/1:1:8YX3-T5N2)
